correctness.rationale: Proved the stated unit ball directly by orthant integral-vertex argument: root vertices are precisely ±ei±ej and norm generators are coordinate ±ek* and half-sign vectors. For each root x and generator f, either |f(x)|=1 or exact decomposition x=y+z into two root vertices each normed (up to sign) by f yields ||Tx||<=2v(T). Norm is attained at root vertex, proving universal v(T)>=||T||/2 for all real operators and all d>=4. The rank-one T(x)=(x1+x2)e3 has ||T||=2, v(T)=1 via a complete norming-facet case distinction. Independently exhausted each root/generator pair and evaluated the rank-one witness for d=4,5,6,7. The all-dimensional argument, not the finite checks, proves the theorem.
